steps.text: Go up through Kazordoon to Emperor Kruzak's chambers.
steps.source: First you need to go to Emperor Kruzak's chambers in his private room, to the north.

steps.text: At the end of the west secret passage: key 3800 in the chest. Don't take the hole down, go back to the emperor's room.
steps.source: Get Key 3800 which can be found at the end of the west "secret passage" exit, in a Chest. Do not take the exit route down the hole, but go back to the king's room.

steps.text: Open the small room in the emperor's chamber with key 3800: 27 cookies and key 3801 in the chest.
steps.source: Open the door of the small room in the emperor's chamber with the key. In the chest in the room you opened will be 7 and 20 Cookies and Key 3801.

steps.text: Go back down to the barracks and open the door with key 3801: key 3802 is in the chest (it opens Dwacatra prison and the Mine Hub).
steps.source: When at the barracks you can open the door with Key 3801, in the Chest will be the key, Key 3802, this key is needed to open Dwacatra Prison and a specific room in the Dwarf Mines.
